comment: meta-factory's own commissioned lanes (#193). The owner commissioned four instrument lanes on 2026-09-27 -- ledger, questions, pacemakers, methodology -- each owning one template instrument's development and cross-member deployment. They resolve through registry/factories/meta-factory.json's `lanes` (threads 3981 / 4087 / 4223 / 4186), so the derived actor is the role name below. Membership alone would have left them REFUSED: known_actors() reads this file's `actors` list, and authorized_for_event() unions `by_event` onto the core matrix, so a lane declared for membership and absent here for authorization resolves and is then refused BY NAME -- which is the better error and the point of #193. THE SET IS UNIFORM ON PURPOSE: the four lanes do the same kind of work (take a unit, settle it, report), and a differentiated set would encode a distinction no measurement supports. NOT GRANTED, and each for a stated reason: `intake` and `dispatch` are Triage's rows (SKILL.md section 4), `ruling` is the process owner's, `score` is Surveys' measurement duty, `genesis` is bootstrap-only. A lane that files a board item therefore still owes Triage its intake leg -- the delegation of work does not move the routing.
